description: This file defines functions and data related to plugin SDK entry points for a project, including building source paths, specifiers, package exports, and listing distribution artifacts.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkEntrySources
methods.description: Generates an object mapping plugin SDK entry names to their source file paths.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkSpecifiers
methods.description: Creates an array of module specifiers for each plugin SDK entry.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkPackageExports
methods.description: Builds an object mapping export paths to their corresponding type definition and JavaScript files.

methods.name: listPluginSdkDistArtifacts
methods.description: Returns a list of distribution artifact file paths for all plugin SDK entries.
